review: One exclusive global attempt owns three sequential direct-child sessions, with separate immutable phase attempts and terminal receipts.

CPU counters include monitor own usage, reaped children and live owned process trees. Phase receipts are cumulative and are not summed. The global final value and differences provide search/confirmation accounting.
Both search phases enforce cumulative 3600 CPU seconds; confirmation cap is min(5400, actual_search_cpu+1800). Ten-second cleanup margins remain. Global wall cap is 3600 seconds.

Parent checks bind exact phase attempt path/hash, protocol/release hashes, monitor PID/start ticks, parent PID and same PID namespace. Search additionally matches its arm path; confirmation requires active confirmation phase.
Cleanup reaps exited leaders and surviving or escaped descendants, with same-namespace proof and pidfd/start-tick checks for individual signals.

Worker address space is limited to 8 GiB. Owned process aggregate RSS is stopped at 4 GiB and host available memory below 4 GiB blocks launch or stops work. Retained sampled RSS peaks cannot disappear before final completeness checks.

First failure stops subsequent phases; no resume, extra cohort, partial confirmation or automatic cap extension exists. Complete status requires all expected markers, raw row hashes, cleared process groups and bounded final accounting.

tests.synthetic_scope: Tiny Python CPU/sleep processes; no large memory allocation. Main aggregate arithmetic uses fabricated phase receipts, and a separate test executes three actual owned Python children to prove cumulative accounting and cleanup.

resolved_findings: Root corrected record-only memory peak threshold crossing before this review; focused regression passed.
retained_audit_errors: Namespace initial receipt reused a variable and omitted native list; numeric scan was intact, corrected scan retained all 68 IDs.
Literal classifier initially expected ranges rather than historical Y named block metadata; old error and corrected explicit schema handling retained.
Additional sequential test initially had an escaped-newline syntax error before any child launch; only test quoting changed.
limitations: This is source and synthetic lifecycle verification, not a simulation or live resource clearance. Root separately clears the host namespace before release.
Historical timing projections are planning estimates. Newly developed genotypes and the combined case can cost more; hard caps decide completion.
Sampled RSS is not a hard instantaneous process-tree memory limit; per-process RLIMIT_AS provides an additional bound.
